title: Nine Streets of Power
subtitle: 首都与资本 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 首都与资本（历史社会与文化·国家与城市）
meta: 主题语境：首都与资本（历史社会与文化·国家与城市）　|　核心词汇：capital　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 capital 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to leave ① a capital she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② capital, meaning the city and not the money, was nine streets from the river and was governed by whoever came last; a capital, she said, is the only thing in a country that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ capital in that atlas had the same dome, and the ④ capital at the north, meaning the one the minister kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever drawn properly. A capital, my grandmother said, is nine parts stone and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the stone is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ capital was the whole of the business, meaning the money behind it and not the city. The ⑥ capital, meaning the money and not any of that, is the only thing in a firm that everybody borrows and nobody questions; a capital, he said, is either somewhere you leave or the only word that means both a city and money. She said the money is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ capital had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the dome. The ⑧ capital of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine streets and eleven years of leaving; a capital, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ capital I remember is the one at the north, which was drawn in 1968 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ capital, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being governed; every capital, she said, is money that has agreed to look like a city. She said the money was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 首都（指那座城本身，与钱相对）
C. 固定搭配：leave a capital 离开首都
D. n. 首都（指地图册上每一座）
E. n. 首都（指北面那一座）
F. n. 资本；资金（抽象：与那座城相对）
G. n. 那笔资金（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a capital she could not name
The capital, meaning the city and not the money
capital was the whole of the business
the capital had become a photograph in a report
The capital of the whole thing
A capital, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: leave a capital 意为“离开首都”，1946 年母亲被派离开一座她说不出名字的首都。
capital 意为“首都”，指那座城本身而不是钱，离河九条街，由最后走的人治理。
capital 指地图册上每一座首都，每一座都是同样的圆顶。
capital 指北面那一座（大臣所在的那座），是唯一有人认真画过的。
capital 意为“资本、资金”，与那座城相对，父亲说 capital 就是那门生意的全部。
capital 为抽象用法，指那笔资金本身，是公司里人人都借、却没人质疑的东西。
capital 意为“首都、首府”，到 1963 年这座 capital 成了报告里的一张照片。
capital 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九条街和十一年的离开。
capital 意为“首都”，我记得的是北面那一座，1968 年被画下，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
capital 为抽象总称，祖母说首都是唯一会因为被好好治理而变好的地方。
